title: return apologize and serve relay
context: Year 1 Volume 5; scene-specific competition conditions and asymmetric knowledge gates apply.
observed_actions: Sudō seeks Suzune's permission to call her by her given name and works toward MVP partly from romantic attraction and desire for recognition. After feeling humiliated and abandoning the festival he reveals insecurity over social respect, and returns when Suzune acknowledges him.
observed_result: His motivational mix shifts toward earning respect from a valued individual plus classmates, and he explicitly promises not to resort to unjustified violence. Suzune accepts the first-name address even when he misses MVP.
epistemic_limits: The romantic interest is Sudō's; Suzune never declares reciprocal romance. A promise of self-control is not proof of future compliance, nor is MVP sufficient to produce a relationship.
information_available: Only actors participating in the scene know their own actions; narrated thoughts and later private revelations never create global actor memories.
counterfactual_test: Compare against same event, equipment, rest, teammates, opponents and information, preserving injury/obstruction and luck. Unobserved counterfactual remains unknown.
